div.div: زِمْلَةٌ Luxuriant, or abundant, and dense [palmtrees such as are termed] جَبَّار: [الجُمّار in the CK is a mistranscription:] and a collection of وَدِىّ [i. e. small young palm-trees, or shoots cut off from palm-trees and planted]: and young palm-trees exceeding the reach of the hand: (K, TA:) all on the authority of El-Hejeree. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
